\chapter{Bus, Vehicle, and Cart: No New Signs}
\label{ch:mw-transport-three}
\hlchaptermodality{21}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise, say, read, and write bus, vehicle, and cart using only signs already secured in earlier chapters.}

Three source-attested transport words begin by ear, reuse the established script inventory, and finish in four separately scored skills without claiming a ticket or timetable exchange.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[bas]{Hear \emph{bas} — bus}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-hear-bas}



\begin{quote}
Recall the seven-word shopping payoff, then say expensive and price.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{bas} — \textbf{bus}
\end{quote}

Hear it twice, picture a bus, and say it once. Keep the spelling covered until the sound and meaning are easy.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\mw{बस} (bas)}{बस (bas)}]{\mw{बस} — bus on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-bas}



\begin{quote}
Say bus and maternal grandfather. \emph{Write it:} the words for expensive and price
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{ब}} + \textbf{\mw{स}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{बस}} — \emph{bas} — bus
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\emph{Cover:} the model after one look, then wait five seconds

\emph{Write it:} \textbf{\mw{बस}}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[gāṛī]{Hear \emph{gāṛī} — vehicle}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-hear-gaadi}



\begin{quote}
Say bus and clothes. \emph{Write it:} the words for bus and maternal grandfather, then \textbf{\mw{ड़}}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{gāṛī} — \textbf{vehicle}
\end{quote}

Use vehicle as the broad meaning here. Hear the curled middle sound, then say the word once from a vehicle picture.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\mw{गाड़ी} (gāṛī)}{गाड़ी (gāṛī)}]{\mw{गाड़ी} — vehicle on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-gaadi}



\begin{quote}
Say vehicle and maternal grandmother. \emph{Write it:} the word for clothes

Then recall the three-word shopping payoff.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{गा}} + \textbf{\mw{ड़ी}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{गाड़ी}} — \emph{gāṛī} — vehicle
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\emph{Cover:} the model after one look, then wait five seconds

\emph{Write it:} \textbf{\mw{गाड़ी}} — keep the dot below \textbf{\mw{ड}} and the long-ī mark after it

\section[Practice]{Retrieve three transport words}

\label{lesson:MW-R16-transport-three}



\begin{quote}
Recall the seven-word shopping payoff. \emph{Write it:} \textbf{\mw{त}}, the word for cheap, and \textbf{\mw{ड़}}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\section[Practice]{Payoff — three transport words in four skills}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-transport-three}



\begin{quote}
\emph{Write it:} the word for husband

Then say goods.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{enumerate}
\raggedright
  \item Identify three heard words.
  \item Produce three words from meaning cues.
  \item \emph{Read it:} three printed cards and match them to meanings
  \item \emph{Write it:} all three heard words without a model
\end{enumerate}

Pass each skill separately. Timetables, tickets, and location phrases remain later work.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}

\end{quote}
